title: term.diff: where the generator occurrences of a term come from in the term it replaces, when no rewrite connects them (text edited by hand)

summands.description: Compare only the first so many summands of each side that are not found unchanged (0: all).

before.description: The words of the summands of 'before', in printed order: the summands the provenance map's occurrences [summand, layer] refer to.

provenance.description: A summand whose word 'before' also has descends from it unchanged; each other summand from at most one other summand of 'before', paired best aligned first, its layers from the layers of the same generator the alignment keeps (docs/conventions.md, Provenance).

truncated.description: Some changed summands were beyond the 'summands' limit and were not compared: their layers descend from nothing.
